# Untis+ 5.3.3

This release expands alarms and widgets, while refining settings and app state handling.

## Highlights
- Add a Smart Alarm area that can schedule manual and timetable-based alarms on Android.
- Add dedicated settings for home-screen widgets and refreshed Android widget layouts.
- Extend iOS widget timelines and the Android widget configuration flow.

## Improvements
- Keep alarm, notification, backup and account-related settings integrated with the app state.
- Improve settings widgets and appearance handling.
- Refresh launcher and widget visual resources.

## Notes
- The changelog first loads the latest stable GitHub release and remains available offline through this bundled fallback.
- Android updates are only offered when a compatible APK is attached to a release.
